title: SEAMLESS Active Technique Runtime Prerequisites Audit

entries.description: Attacker has active control over the executing actor
entries.rationale: Evaluated strictly from branch AttackState.control or usable_identity. Never an external assumption.
entries.failure_mode: Halts execution immediately if actor is not in control.

entries.description: Actor identity is usable within the current authentication context
entries.rationale: Evaluated from branch AttackState.usable_identity matching context.authentication_context.
entries.failure_mode: Halts execution; unauthenticated actor cannot invoke techniques.

entries.description: Source principal is actor or group where actor is an effective member
entries.rationale: Evaluated dynamically from branch AttackState.effective_member.
entries.failure_mode: Halts execution; actor cannot exercise rights of unjoined groups.

entries.description: Source computer host is under administrative control
entries.rationale: Evaluated from branch AttackState.admin_control.
entries.failure_mode: Halts execution; credential dumping requires prior host compromise.

entries.description: Actor holds capability to reset passwords on target
entries.rationale: Evaluated from branch AttackState.reset_password_control.
entries.failure_mode: Halts execution; acquire_reset_identity requires prior reset.

entries.description: Target matches the authentication context of the query
entries.rationale: Evaluated by comparing target node ID with context auth context.
entries.failure_mode: Blocks transition if credentials bound to different context.

entries.description: Target identity is known to the attacker
entries.rationale: Evaluated from AttackState.known_identity.
entries.failure_mode: Blocks roasting and delegation if identity is undiscovered.

entries.description: Foothold has capability to send raw AS-REQ packets
entries.rationale: Evaluated from AttackState.asrep_request_capability.
entries.failure_mode: Blocks asrep_request if foothold lacks AS-REQ capability.

entries.description: User account has Kerberos preauthentication disabled
entries.rationale: Authoritative property collected in BloodHound v3 snapshot facts.
entries.failure_mode: Snapshot lookup vetoes asrep_request if dontreqpreauth is False.

entries.description: User account has registered Service Principal Names
entries.rationale: Authoritative property from users.json serviceprincipalnames array.
entries.failure_mode: Blocks kerberoast_request if account has no SPN.

entries.description: List of SPNs registered on the user object
entries.rationale: Authoritative property from snapshot facts.
entries.failure_mode: Blocks service ticket acquisition if SPN list is empty.

entries.description: Actor object enabled status in Active Directory
entries.rationale: Authoritative property from snapshot. If False, triggers veto.
entries.failure_mode: Known-false veto if False; satisfies if True.

entries.description: Target object enabled status in Active Directory
entries.rationale: Authoritative property from snapshot. If False, triggers veto.
entries.failure_mode: Known-false veto if False; satisfies if True.

entries.description: KDC port 88 reachable over intranet network
entries.rationale: Standard AD intranet condition; DCs reachable from domain members.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: MS-RPC port 135 and dynamic ports reachable for SAMR
entries.rationale: Standard AD condition for directory management operations.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: WinRM ports 5985/5986 reachable on target computers
entries.rationale: Standard enterprise condition for remote computer management.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: WinRM service is active and listening on target computer
entries.rationale: Expected state for remote administration targets under policy.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: KDC accepts AS-REQ for accounts with preauth disabled
entries.rationale: Standard RFC 4120 behavior implemented by Active Directory KDC.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: KDC issues TGS service ticket for valid registered SPN
entries.rationale: Standard RFC 4120 Kerberos behavior for authenticated users.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Kerberos authentication operational on client system
entries.rationale: Standard condition on Windows domain member systems.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Logon session holds valid initial Kerberos TGT
entries.rationale: Standard condition for authenticated domain user logon.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Administrative channel open for local administrators
entries.rationale: Standard condition for hosts where identity has AdminTo rights.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Host execution environment allows administrative command execution
entries.rationale: Standard condition for local administrator sessions.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Target endpoint authorizes management connections
entries.rationale: Corresponds to local administrator rights on target system.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Local administrator group mapping corresponds to AdminTo
entries.rationale: Standard mapping of Domain Admins or delegated local admins.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Target accepts valid domain credentials for authentication
entries.rationale: Standard Active Directory domain member authentication behavior.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: WinRM listener validates administrative domain credentials
entries.rationale: Standard behavior for remote management users.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Remote Desktop service enabled and accepting connections
entries.rationale: Standard condition for CanRDP edge targets in enterprise.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: WinRM remoting endpoint available on target host
entries.rationale: Standard condition for CanPSRemote edge targets.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Directory modification allowed under GenericAll or WriteDacl
entries.rationale: Standard AD DACL semantics: object ACE grants modification.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Password reset complies with length and complexity policy
entries.rationale: Attacker can generate passwords conforming to domain policy.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Adding members to group is permitted under GenericAll
entries.rationale: Standard AD object control behavior for security groups.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Group SID is incorporated into access token upon session logon
entries.rationale: Standard Kerberos/NTLM PAC authorization token construction.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Secret matches directory hash and is unexpired
entries.rationale: Once secret is recovered or set, authentication succeeds.
entries.failure_mode: Unresolved in raw mode; resolved True under scenario profile.

entries.description: Target group is a security group capable of token authorization
entries.rationale: Safely conditionable for recognized security groups. FORBIDDEN from defaulting to True for groups named DISTLIST or DISTRIBUTION.
entries.failure_mode: Rejected for distribution groups; resolved True for security groups.

entries.description: Offline password recovery successfully cracks ticket or hash
entries.rationale: Depends on password complexity, dictionary, and GPU budget. FORBIDDEN from defaulting to True in standard mode. Requires explicit recovery_opt_in with method and budget. Never implies P=1.
entries.failure_mode: Halts prefix replay at recovery step without explicit opt-in.

entries.description: Cached logon session in LSASS is unexpired and active
entries.rationale: Requires live telemetry or explicit scoped override.
entries.failure_mode: Cannot default in standard profile; requires specific override.

entries.description: Target user session currently exists in LSASS memory
entries.rationale: Requires live telemetry or explicit scoped override.
entries.failure_mode: Cannot default in standard profile; requires specific override.

entries.description: LSASS memory is readable by elevated process
entries.rationale: Requires endpoint security configuration evidence.
entries.failure_mode: Cannot default in standard profile; requires specific override.

entries.description: RBCD delegation gates (s4u_request_accepted, delegation_policy_allows)
entries.rationale: Requires specific RBCD recipe bindings and explicit delegation opt-in.
entries.failure_mode: Cannot default in standard profile; requires specific override.

entries.description: Attacker holds credentials and interactive logon rights
entries.rationale: Attacker capability must come strictly from foothold or valid technique effects. Never granted by assumption.
entries.failure_mode: Policy rejects any attempt to assume this predicate.

entries.description: Attacker holds elevated code execution on target computer
entries.rationale: Goal capability must be attained through applicable technique chain. Never granted by assumption.
entries.failure_mode: Policy rejects any attempt to assume this predicate.

entries.description: Direct administrative control over object
entries.rationale: Must come from initial foothold. Never assumed by policy.
entries.failure_mode: Policy rejects any attempt to assume this predicate.

entries.description: Structural relationship exists in the Active Directory directory
entries.rationale: Canonical graph structure is immutable; policy cannot invent edges.
entries.failure_mode: Policy rejects any attempt to assume non-existent structural edges.
